shared_elements: carved stone surface with relief decoration
repeated small emblematic signs arranged in rows
justification: Both are upright stone works bearing figural relief with a prominent disc motif and some horizontal division of the field, and both include small repeated emblem-like signs. But A is a massive three-dimensional block carved in bold, eroded, rounded volumes with a figure conceived in the round, while B is a thin flat slab with crisp shallow linear incision organised into a clear picture panel above and neat registers of script below — the manner of cutting and the compositional logic are quite unrelated.
